title: Accordion
api:
interface AccordionItem {
  value: string
  title: ReactNode
  content: ReactNode
  disabled?: boolean
}

interface AccordionProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue'> {
  items: AccordionItem[]
  value?: string[]
  defaultValue?: string[]
  onValueChange?: (value: string[]) => void
  multiple?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}

function Accordion({
  items,
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  multiple = false,
  disabled = false,
  className,
  ...props
}: AccordionProps);
